title: The Palm Grove Pavilion
subtitle: An Elegant Residence with a Private Tropical Garden
description:
Nestled within a lush tropical grove in Puerto Aventuras, The Palm Grove Pavilion offers a refined living experience. This contemporary residence distinguishes itself with a privileged location and serene views over the private garden canopy, seamlessly blending classic tropical architecture with modern comfort. It is a haven of absolute calm in the heart of the Riviera Maya's most exclusive community.

The Residence
Built on a 5,167 sq ft lot, the home provides 3,767 sq ft of bright and airy living space, flawlessly distributed across four bedrooms that can comfortably accommodate up to eleven guests. The three full bathrooms are elegantly finished with solid granite and marble. Authentic cupula ceilings in the living room, dining area, and primary bedroom add a distinct architectural character, bathing the interiors in exceptional natural light.

Curated Outdoor Spaces
The outdoor environment is designed for pure enjoyment and complete autonomy. A large climate-controlled pool serves as the centerpiece, surrounded by a dense, mature garden. Two spacious terraces offer immersive views over the verdant foliage. The home is engineered for quiet independence, featuring a 22 KW standby generator, solar panels, and a comprehensive water softening system to ensure a frictionless daily experience.

The Lifestyle
Residing at The Palm Grove Pavilion includes access to the secure gated community of Puerto Aventuras, featuring world class marinas, fine dining, and an exclusive Beach Club. The Caribbean shore is only moments away. This property presents a rare opportunity to acquire a turnkey luxury residence in a tropical jungle setting, offered at $895,000 and ready for immediate enjoyment.
